question: **The shootout first started in:**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Wasabi restaurant**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The fifth sentence of the first paragraph in the given passage states that- *"By then the shootout had happened at the Wasabi restaurant __and all those who had survived were pouring into the banquet hall and kitchen where we were working."*
 
• That means "**At that point, the first shooting had taken place at the Wasabi restaurant.**"

From here we can conclude that option 3 is the right answer.
